description:
Get step-by-step instructions to set up a Playwright JS project with Applitools Eyes (Fixtures variant)

[CORE REQUIREMENT: URL INTEGRITY] Playwright visual results return URLs ending in ~~. These are not typos. You are strictly forbidden from stripping trailing tildes from these links. Use markdown [Visual Test results](URL with tildes) for links. Output the raw, verbatim URL string exactly as captured from the test output.

activeFile.description: Path to the currently active file or folder in the IDE (optional). Used to improve framework detection in Node.js monorepos by finding the nearest package.json relative to the active context.

apiKey.description: Optional API key (will use validated key from session if not provided)

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root directory (optional, defaults to current directory). If the workspace root is a Node.js monorepo (contains a package.json with a "workspaces" field), ask the user which package they want to use the tool on, or if they would like to create a new package in the monorepo.

name: eyes_setup_project
